title: ajuga tenorei
intro: Ajuga tenorei, commonly known as Ajuga, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family that is native to the Mediterranean region. The plant has been found to possess numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat various digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ajuga tenorei include its potential to act as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of Ajuga tenorei include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
